label: The Dolomites become his training ground
detail: First 3,000 m summit in 1949 at age five; Messner’s official chronology records 500 Eastern Alpine ascents, mainly in the Dolomites, from 1950 to 1964.

label: First summit with his father
detail: A childhood beginning in the mountains.

label: Nanga Parbat
detail: Reinhold and Günther reach the summit; Günther dies during the descent two days later.

label: Everest without supplemental oxygen
detail: First Everest ascent without supplemental oxygen, with Peter Habeler.

label: Solo Everest
detail: First solo ascent of Everest without supplemental oxygen.

label: Completes his sequence on all 14 eight-thousanders
detail: By 1986, Messner had completed ascents of all fourteen distinct eight-thousanders. His claim to be the first remains contested over the 1985 Annapurna summit position.

label: Member of the European Parliament
detail: A period of public and political work.

label: Messner Mountain Museum
detail: The first Messner Mountain Museum opens; the project began in 2003.
